setup.design: frequency-aware GPU virtualization with two dedicated shells, one shared shell for low-frequency models, predictive prefetch, and action-consumption-aware phase shifting

notes: strict_horizon means each chunk must be served at the sampled AutoHorizon point.
phase_shift allows request service to slide within a safe action-consumption window [min(horizon, floor), chunk_size].
The policy keeps 30Hz and 20Hz models on dedicated shells and shares one shell between two 10Hz models.
